column1: # DRY-RUN ONLY partition table — canonical partitions.csv + an `efuse_em`
# emulation partition. Referenced ONLY from sdkconfig.secure.virtual.
# WHY a separate file: EFUSE_VIRTUAL_KEEP_IN_FLASH needs a dedicated
# `efuse` partition to persist the simulated eFuse block across reboots;
# without it the bootloader aborts in the flash-encryption pass (caught
# on hardware 2026-05-19). The REAL burn uses real eFuses and therefore
# the unchanged canonical partitions.csv — Track 0 offsets (nvs 0x9000
# behaviour on the real partitions is validated faithfully; the only
# delta is the extra emulation-backing region appended AFTER prov in
# otherwise-free 16 MB flash. It never ships.
